_note: Landmarks in zones (queue item 1.4, cghath 2026-10-21; ZoneModules.landmark_kinds, place_landmarks, place_harbour). A zone's landmark sites (BuildingGen.site kinds) come from its asset tags ('tags': data/contracts.json zones' 'assets', docs/terror_groups.md 7.3), its holder's own site ('site_names': what a faction's factions.json 'site_names' call its cache; the Kestrels' and the Syndicate's drug lab, the Banner's and the Shura's IED workshop) and a few by zone id ('zones': the types no tag names). In 'order' first, at most 'max' a zone ('contract' or 'hot' zones). 'ruin': the share of a zone's landmarks [ruined, bombed out]. All Proposed.
